quoted_text:
Update from Ledger Donjon on the CryptoBilis investigation 🔽

@DonjonLedger is investigating Ledger signers sold by CryptoBilis, a reseller in Southeast Asia, that contained an unauthorized hardware implant. Ledger confirmed this on October 10th for one affected user's signer. All confirmed fund losses tied to the incident disclosed on October 9th involve signers sold through CryptoBilis. We have not verified a drain linked to a signer bought elsewhere. CryptoBilis has confirmed it stopped selling Ledger signers while the investigation continues.

Based on the Donjon's analysis of the attack, the implant sits inside the enclosure and reads the data shown on the screen. During setup, the signer displays the 24-word recovery phrase. When the implant detects these screens, its microcontroller decodes the words and transmits them over LTE using a provisioned eSIM. The implant is a separate component. It does not modify the Secure Element or the Ledger operating system, and it does not alter transactions or signatures.

The Donjon will analyze the signers it receives and will share more as the investigation continues.

We have not confirmed the total number of affected users or the total value lost. Figures circulating online come from third parties and Ledger has not fully verified them. If your funds were drained and you have not contacted us, please do so through Ledger Support so we can include your case. We are also reviewing reports of implants in other signers and locations. We will continue to share information as the investigation progresses. Rest assured the Ledger team is going above and beyond to leave no stone unturned to investigate this situation to the strongest possible outcome.

If you bought a Ledger signer from CryptoBilis and have not set it up, do not set it up and contact Ledger Support. If you have set it up, transfer your assets promptly to a new signer with a new recovery phrase. Do not enter or restore any recovery phrase on a signer bought from CryptoBilis. Never enter your recovery phrase into a website, app or form.

If you lost funds or hold a tampered signer, contact Ledger Support at https://t.co/QzukOZdEzq and file a report with local law enforcement. Do not send the signer to anyone before speaking with Ledger Support or local law enforcement. If you lost funds, coordinate with law enforcement before opening the signer. Researchers and others with relevant information can write to security@ledger.com.

If you did not buy from CryptoBilis and want to inspect the inside of your signer, the guide is at https://t.co/Bh9DHQulIv. Use caution and make sure your recovery phrase is backed up first, because opening a signer can damage it.

Ledger will never call you, message you directly, or ask for your 24-word recovery phrase. We will update this post when we verify new information.

text:
Ledger 确认东南亚经销商 CryptoBilis 售出硬件钱包被植入恶意组件：可窃取助记词

据 Ledger 官方发文，其安全团队 Ledger Donjon 正在调查由东南亚经销商 CryptoBilis 售出的 Ledger 签名设备（signer），该批设备被植入未经授权的硬件组件。Ledger 于 10 月 10 日就一名受影响用户的设备确认此事。

Donjon 分析显示，植入物位于设备外壳内，可读取屏幕显示内容——在初始设置时解码 24 词恢复助记词，并经内置 eSIM 通过 LTE 外传；该组件不改动安全芯片、系统或交易签名。

目前与 10 月 9 日披露事件相关的已确认资金损失均涉及经 CryptoBilis 售出的设备。CryptoBilis 已停售 Ledger 设备。受影响用户总数及损失金额尚未核实，Ledger 正排查其他经销商与地区的类似植入报告。

Robinhood 链真正的大招，可能不是链本身，而是 AI。

昨天凌晨的 AMA 里，
大家都在追问 Robinhood Chain，
但我觉得，被问得第二多的那个问题更值得看：

Robinhood Agents，AI 交易代理。

先看 Vlad 是怎么回答的：

· 什么时候上线？
“很快。我们在谨慎推出，先做对，再交到所有人手上。”

· 怎么看 AI 代理交易？
“我认为这是人们投资方式的下一个大转变。AI 负责跑腿，最终决定权在你手上。”

· 大家都用同样的 AI 策略，会不会放大波动？
“代理围绕每个用户自己的目标运作，内置护栏，你始终掌控。”

单看这些，就是一家券商在做 AI 功能。
但把它和 Robinhood 链放在一起看，味道就不一样了。

1. AI 不睡觉，美股会休市

传统美股一周只开 32.5 小时。
AI 代理是 7×24 小时在跑的。

一个全天候工作的 AI，
碰上一个每天收盘、周末关门的市场，
它最自然的去处是哪里？

链上。

Robinhood 链上已经有 190+ 只股票代币，全天候可交易。
AI 代理和链上美股，本来就是一对。

2. 机构也在押这个方向

上周 Citrini Research 发了一份研报《Breaking The Wall》，核心观点就一句：

AI 代理会大幅拉动对 7×24 链上结算、代币化股票和链上借贷的需求。

研报一出，篮子里的币当天就有拉升 20%+ 的。
市场是认这个逻辑的。

3. Robinhood 手里有别人没有的东西

做 AI 交易代理的团队很多，
但同时拥有这三样的，几乎只有 Robinhood：

· 数千万真实券商用户
· 一条自己的链，190+ 只股票代币
· 合规牌照和现成的产品入口

Vlad 那句话我反复看了几遍：
“接进数百万用户已经在用的 Robinhood 产品。”

如果有一天，App 里的 AI 代理可以直接调用链上的股票代币，
那 Robinhood 链缺的就不是叙事，而是承接能力了。

我的看法：

现在链上热度在退，大家都在问 Robinhood 链的增量从哪来。

我的答案是：
下一波增量用户，可能根本不是人，而是 AI。

当然，现在一切都还停留在“很快”。
Agents 什么时候上线、能不能碰到链上资产，都还没有官方答案。

但这条线，值得提前放进观察列表。

most people only just discovered @Collector_Crypt and are probably wondering: what the hell is even Ripmart?

there‘s been a lot of rumors and speculation around it, but this recent livestream by @TuomHolmberg and @chrisakvn essentially says it all. so let me break it down for you:

one of the fastest growing trends in commerce right now is live shopping. Pioneered by Whatnot, and now followed by essentially every big platform: TikTok Shop, eBay Live, you name it.

think of Ripmart as the first truly onchain native version of something like Whatnot, powered by Collector Crypt's infrastructure.

why is this so exciting? a few reasons.

the UX.

as a collector, you don't rip packs on a livestream just because it's fun. you do it chasing that one grail you've always wanted. most of the time you don't hit it, that's part of the game, and you end up at home with a pile of worthless cards you never wanted and spent way too much money on.

with Collector Crypt underneath, Ripmart changes that. instant liquidity through buyback offers, just like you know from the gacha. you can immediately sell back, preserve your liquidity, and get way more runway to keep chasing the grail you actually want, while no more pile of worthless cards at home.

sounds simple, but that one feature gives collectors a 10x better experience (and likely also success rate in finding their grail). which makes choosing Ripmart over Whatnot and the rest a no brainer going forward.

then there is the onchain adoption.

the onchain part is obviously fully abstracted away. it just feels like using a slick new livestreaming and social app.

but what that means for @solana and @Collector_Crypt is massive. this is one of those rare events that could onboard hundreds of thousands, maybe millions of users onchain without them even realizing it, driven purely by their love for collectibles and a genuinely great shopping experience.

and let this sink in: every single pack ripped gets tokenized in real time through Collector Crypt's infrastructure. 

the supply of tokenized collectibles on Solana is about to explode. it brings a ton of liquidity to Collector's marketplace, better discovery, and adds an entirely new, highly sought after asset class on top: ungraded cards.

the traction this brings to CC and Solana is going to be huge. and the best part: it's fully organic and therefore sustainable, driven by an asset class people genuinely love and an experience orders of magnitude better than anything out there today.

and of course, Tuom wouldn't be Tuom if there wasn't a lot more going on behind the scenes, stuff beyond most people's imagination, that'll make sure Ripmart isn't just a nice idea but gets the adoption it deserves from day one.

but more on that later, once the time is right.

until then: Tuom mode.

text:
XinGPT周度报告之机构在想什么（一）：长债利率见顶了吗？

10月7日至9日，美国长端国债收益率从高位回落：10年期从5.28%降至5.24%，30年期从5.67%降至5.60%。此前持续承压的长债出现反弹，近期拍卖也显示，高收益率正在吸引买盘。

10月7日，390亿美元10年期国债拍卖投标倍数达到2.77，交易商仅承接约2.5%；次日220亿美元30年期拍卖投标倍数为2.54，中标收益率5.618%，略低于发行前市场收益率。供给顺利被消化，让“长债利率见顶”重新成为值得关注的交易预期。

机构端美银的最新Flow Show显示，国债基金当周流入162亿美元，投资级债流入103亿美元。Hartnett开始少量布局长债、小盘、REITs和香港地产，押注利率见顶后融资压力缓和。

10月初的新数据强化了增长降速的信号。10月2日公布的9月非农仅增加2.9万人，低于此前12个月平均的4.5万人，但失业率仍为4.2%，尚未显示突然恶化。9月服务业PMI从55.4降至54.9，商业活动从61.7降至56.5，新订单从60.9降至59.8。服务业仍在扩张，但速度放缓，为配置长债、对冲增长风险提供理由。

关键变化是增长降速没有伴随成本降温：制造业价格指数从71.1升至77.9，服务业从72.6升至74.0；制造业新订单还从53.7升至55.3。市场面对的是活动放缓与成本升温并存。

这组变化支持防守需求，却未打开明确的宽松空间。Waller在10月8日仍强调就业稳定、通胀偏高；其引用的10月7日期货快照显示，年末前至少一次加息概率约85%。

因此，近期买债可理解为锁定高收益率、对冲增长风险；要判断是否已经转向降息交易，还需看利率分项。增长与盈利担忧也可能抵消利率下降对科技股估值的帮助，债券反弹未必意味着股票同步受益。

公用事业 XLU、必需消费 XLP、医疗 XLV等表现强于科技。

text:
New post on Eth Research!

Rapidblocks, take two: a pipelined consensus for independent blocks

By:
- cskiraly

🔗 https://t.co/o7CMMJqpSY

Highlights:
- Blocks are made mostly independent by separating dependencies into two edge types: “Hist” (state executed on) and “refs” (filters respected). A block must avoid touching keys modified by concurrent blocks it doesn’t build on (compatibility via access/modify sets and Bloom-like filters).
- Consensus is reframed to decide one value per slot (a block header hash or ⊥), not to pick a single chain head; the canonical set is derived deterministically from these per-slot decisions plus feasibility/compatibility rules, letting blocks be skipped without reorgs and enabling very short slots.
- The voting protocol is a pipelined, multi-round window vote (Round 0 header timeliness, Round A body availability/validity/feasibility, then follow rounds with view-merge and a thin-view fallback), plus two key anti-attack rules: “own values” (don’t chase tallies still in progress) and “closure” (don’t fast-confirm blocks that depend on not-yet-locked decisions).
- Safety and liveness hinge primarily on networking latency for aggregated votes: safety requires vote latency ℓ ≤ mτ − 2Δ (e.g., ~1.0s when τ=2s, Δ=0.5s, m=1; ~3.0s at m=2). With good latency, confirmations arrive in ~3s and the pipeline behaves like ‘build on the block two slots back, reference the previous one’.
- Empirical mainnet measurement (sample of 501 blocks sliced into 2s chunks) suggests most traffic could use the “fast path” (≈87% of txs / 69% of gas), but details matter: fee credits must be treated as read-free, conflicts must be tracked per storage slot (not per contract), and filter sizing/false positives become important, especially with multiple concurrent slots.

ELI5:
Imagine making a line of Lego towers where each new tower usually has to sit directly on the last one—so if one tower is missing, everything after it falls. This proposal changes the rules so a new tower can usually sit on the tower from two steps ago, as long as it promises not to touch the same Lego pieces that the skipped tower changed. Then, if one tower is missing or late, you can skip it without knocking down later towers. The paper also designs a voting system so everyone can quickly agree, slot by slot, which towers count, while keeping only a small recent “window” flexible and treating everything older as safely fixed.

text:
A 3-year GPU commit costs more than owning the servers.

Most teams we talk to can't get GPUs on demand anymore, so they sign an offtake to reserve capacity. Decent rates only come with commitments of three years or more. Ask for six months or a year and the hourly price jumps.

When we run the numbers, owning beats a three-year commit, including colo (rented rack space) and power. At the end, you still have a server you can sell.

At $500K to $650K for a new 8x B300 server, owning comes to $3 to $3.70 per GPU-hour over three years before resale. A three-year commit costs $4.40 to $5.30 per GPU-hour, with 30% prepaid. Owning pulls ahead between months 10 and 26.

The hardest part is figuring out what you can sell the hardware for. Used GPU transaction prices aren't public. At Stoa Intelligence, we price five @nvidia platforms every week using executed trades and firm dealer quotes.

The A100 80GB came out in November 2020. One bought at launch hit $0 on the books in November 2025 on a five-year depreciation schedule. Our weekly price for a used 8x A100 system stayed between $51,763 and $58,314 from July 10 to October 2, 2026.

Owning is more doable than it sounds. A complete used 8x A100 server costs under $100K and gives you 640GB of GPU memory in one machine. Used 8x H100 systems got 12% cheaper over the same period. Suppliers on Stoa quote new B300 and B200 systems with firm prices and delivery dates, and used H100 and H200 systems available now.

Renting makes more sense if your usage is spiky or you need a few weeks of extra capacity. Buying takes cash up front, and we help with financing options.

The math and price charts are in the note below.

川普现在的信任危机 — — 越来越多选民认为川普的政策正在增加生活负担。

川普现在最郁闷的应该是很多美国人觉得日子变的更难过了，并且把高物价算到他的头上。

AP-NORC在近期公布的民调显示，65%的美国成年人认为，物价这么高，主要是川普的政策造成的。到了这一步，他再说经济会变好，选民就会拿自己的账单来判断。

大家关心的是买菜、加油、交房租之后，工资还能剩下多少。关税先由美国进口商缴纳，企业可能再通过涨价，把一部分成本转给消费者，伊朗战争又让能源供应多了一层不确定性。

工厂回流、增加工作机会，都需要时间，但生活开支每个月都要付。等了这么久还没觉得轻松，选民自然会怀疑，他到底有没有能力把事情做好。

这种失望也出现在共和党内部。同一份民调中，52%的共和党受访者认为，川普在生活成本上的表现比他们原先期待的更差。这些人未必会改投民主党，但可能没那么愿意去投票。对共和党来说，支持者不出门投票，同样会丢选票。

10月11日公布的 Focaldata 民调显示，在可能投票的人群中，民主党的国会投票支持率领先共和党8个百分点。路透的近期调查也显示，民主党受访者更有投票热情。如果这种情况持续下去，共和党就可能一边失去中间选民，一边叫不动自己的支持者。

在那些本来就只差一点的选区，这足以让共和党丢掉席位。

美国财政部长贝森特表示，美国本周可能扣押约10亿美元与伊朗有关的加密货币，进一步切断伊朗获取和转移资金的渠道。

从此前披露的案件看，这些加密资产有一部分来自石油收入。伊朗受到金融制裁，卖出石油之后，收款和跨境转账都受到限制，于是通过中间商把货款换成加密货币，再转给相关机构，用于资金调拨和对外付款。

美国司法部9月公布的一起案件就涉及这种操作。检方指控，相关网络通过交易所账户和多个钱包，转移了超过15亿美元的伊朗石油销售收入，并申请没收其中约 6,100万 美元的加密资产。这些目前仍属于检方指控。

另一部分是直接用外币买来的。链上分析公司 Elliptic 发现，伊朗央行相关钱包累计购入至少 5.07亿 美元USDT，其中两笔采购使用阿联酋迪拉姆付款。按照该公司的分析，这些 USDT 可能被用于跨境贸易结算，也可能在本地市场换成里亚尔，帮助支撑伊朗的汇率。

但 USDT 有发行方冻结机制。钱即使放在自己的钱包里，被列入黑名单后也可能无法转出。Tether在 9月 表示，今年已经协助冻结约 5.5亿 美元与伊朗有关的 USDT 。

text:
on the vibecoded adobe suite

i think both the effort and the expectations are completely misplaced. illustrator is 39 years old, photoshop 36. people really did expect to catch up in two weeks.

attacking the full suite makes no sense. if you’ve been using photoshop, indesign, or illustrator for 20 years, you’d have opinions. you’d notice even the smallest inconveniences and have ideas for how to improve your workflows. with ai, you’re finally in a position to make bespoke software that serves you perfectly and brings you joy.

look at aseprite, which specializes in pixel art. losslesscut, which does one thing premiere makes unnecessarily complicated. photopea, which started as a browser-based psd viewer and grew into a serious editor over 14 years. figma, which rethought design around collaboration.

each of these projects has a point of view. each understands something about how people actually work.

instead, we get seven adobe-shaped applications, recreating the surface without understanding what led to the underlying decisions. not an alternative vision for creative software, just a checklist of features to imitate.

it’s slopware, and it trivializes decades of genuine attempts to free people from adobe.

the tragedy is that we finally have the tools to make the software we actually want, and instead we’re making the software we already have.

and if you needed any more evidence that this was never about making better software, having finished 40 years of adobe development in two weeks, he’s now moving on to microsoft office.

中国长鑫储存技术进展导致存储板块集体下跌，这可能是今天最大的热点

其实早在Q2财报季的时候就可以发现，中国在人工智能方面的突破与发展是必然的，并且中国产能效率高，对海外市场释放产能快，所以现有人工智能所有产业链被冲击是必然的

不过，这种冲击短期是对高性价比市场以及中低端市场冲击最为明显，而中国在人工智能的产业突破我认为是起到了“鲶鱼”效应，对全球AI产业链短期是有威胁力，但是中长期却可以促进AI产业走向高效+低价的路径，这其实是好事，“卷”往往在长期来看带来的反而是促进作用

不过，虽然短期存储板块被冲击，但是这并不代表基本面被破坏，国际上高端存储以及半导体芯片，目前头部大厂依旧拥有技术优势，起码短期几个季度不用担心被中国产能替代

而今年，韩国半导体以及头部存储企业的跌幅明显，就是我昨天前文所说的宏观压制效果，利好被缩小作用，利空反而被放大，归根结底就是高长债利率+加息预期下，市场流动性信心不足导致

接下里要等周三CPI靴子落地+美国银行股、阿斯麦、台积电财报提振市场，对冲掉目前的利空情绪与信心不足

趋势上，基本面没被破坏，产业叙事依旧存在，宏观压制下导致估值快速修复甚至过度调整，其实也未必不是好事，中期选举前后阶段，能给个黄金坑其实也是不错的机会，当然不可否认，随着中国AI技术的不断突破，往后的美股财报季的严苛成都可能会快速增加！

本周宏观摘要第三弹——美股Q3财报季战役正式打响！

本周美国银行股+阿斯麦+台积电财报，分别代表人工智能产业链的资本供给层、半导体设备层与先进芯片制裁层三个环节

银行股财报好不好决定未来人工资能资本支出的环境是否充沛，阿斯麦则作为核心设备厂家决定关键技术、设备资本开支与产能扩张速度，而台积电则负责提供产能、良品率以及产品价格与封装，决定AI芯片的实际供给能力与制造成本

所以说，这三个板块的财报将会是美股Q3财报季的重点“第一枪”，能否开一个好头，将会决定市场对于后续企业的估值调整

尤其是面对目前全球通胀+长债利率高位的宏观压力，就会出现一个奇妙现象，强劲财报企业VS高无风险收益率，资金该做出如何选择，是否要为企业买单，先看行业环境是否健康，再看个股财报是否强劲，资金才会为目前的估值买单

对于美国银行股，当前处于高长端利率+AI资本开支继续扩张阶段，要通过财报关注贷款增长、净利息收入/净利息收益、投资银行与债务资本市场、信用损失准备金以及管理层指引来综合考量，核心是要看目前宏观环境提高了银行盈利的同时是否开始压制企业融资与信用扩张

所以，想要让Q3财报季有效对抗目前宏观压力，三个板块财报都不能差，如果出师不利，对后续整个Q3财报季都是一种信心打压，会让金融流动性进一步加速收紧

目前的宏观环境对于Q3财报季本身是一种压制效果，利好涨幅受限，且涨幅无法蔓延，会让AI板块出现个股分化的情况，强者恒强，弱者继续弱。当然也不用悲观，只要整体叙事依旧健康，回调就算杀估值，也算是给了再次买入的机会！

TL;DR on @contractclaus:

- What Claus is
Claus is an AI agent built around $CLAUS, an Ethereum token with an upgradeable hook attached to its main Uniswap v4 pool.

- Where the money comes from
Main-pool buys and sells carry 2.3% in disclosed fees, calculated on their ETH value. That includes a 2% project fee funding development, buybacks and burns, NFT staking payouts, and staked LP rewards, plus a 0.3% platform fee. Rewards depend on trading volume.

- The NFT setup
Deposit 50,000 CLAUS to mint one of 300 randomly assigned identities, with one direct mint per wallet. New ETH rewards now require staking, with each daily pool shared according to NFT count and time staked. There’s no minimum staking lock: unstake, then burn the NFT to redeem its 50,000 CLAUS backing.

- SPLASH
Provide both ETH and CLAUS to the main pool, then stake your full-range liquidity position to earn a share of ETH rewards. SPLASH replaces automatic liquidity additions with incentives for participating LPs.

- What’s next
The proposal is for developers and agents to launch evolving projects through @ProgrammableHQ, with Claus reviewing and approving each proposed contract upgrade before execution.

The founder also plans for ecosystem tokens to pair with CLAUS, but the exact benefits for token and NFT holders are still being designed.

$NVDA CES 2025 projections and Elon's prediction on $TSLA + 1 Billion humanoids in the next decade, seems to be speeding up. 

New statement from Unitree CEO after testing GPT-6 on their humanoid program was that:

- In August, before GPT-6's release, Wang said the industry could take two to three years at its fastest pace, or as long as a decade, to reach its "ChatGPT moment"

- Now, OpenAI's GPT-6 model prompted expectations that a breakthrough could happen "within 1 or 2 years"

- He defined that moment as robots being able to complete around 80 per cent of tasks in 80 per cent of unfamiliar environments using voice or text commands.

- "It's possible that, say, a GPT-7 model released next year could directly crack the problems of embodied intelligence"

- "The whole embodied intelligence industry has been shaken up after the release of GPT-6"

Just looking at some benchmarks on robotic hand manipulation, "On the bowl task Astra placed the block in 19 of 20 trials, against Fable 5.1's 8 of 20".

But for the puzzle task "Astra completed the insertion 2 times in 20 against Fable 5.1's 2 in 20"".. so we're getting there. 

But going from 2-3 years (potentially to a decade), and compressing that down to 1 or 2 years (to achieve 80%+ of tasks in unfamiliar environemnts) is a significant change in outlook.

author: sayodotfun
quoted_text:
Today I call upon the blockchain industry to calmly begin planning for "bunker mode". My personal recommendation is to set in motion a controlled mass migration of assets to fresh addresses, i.e. addresses whose pubkeys remain hidden behind a hash.

Holders, starting with large and sophisticated ones, should consider moving the bulk of their funds to addresses that have never signed a transaction. And when they do sign one, they should also move remaining funds to a new address (possibly generated from the same seed phrase).

Don't rush. While I believe there is cause for action a rushed migration would do more harm than good. Don't panic either. Moving assets to protected addresses is a simple, preventative step which does not require new cryptography or new wallets.

IMO it is now reasonable to brace for the possibility that ECDSA breaks before qday, in the worst case in months not years. By "break" I mean fast private key recovery (e.g. in one week) on available hardware (e.g. a large GPU cluster).

Recent days have been humbling for human mathematical intuition. Long-held, unquestioned hypotheses have fallen. This includes the n log(n) bound for integer multiplication and the 3SUM conjecture. In hindsight, May's unexpected disproof of the Erdős unit distance conjecture was our warning shot.

Yesterday's OpenAI drop made it clear that mathematical superintelligence is upon us. They say there are weeks where decades happen. We are about to live through weeks where centuries of mathematical progress happen. Could our magic 64-byte ECDSA signatures be too good to be true? Was it just security through obscurity all this time?

Elliptic curves feel especially vulnerable to superintelligence. Curves carry rich structure, with room for fancy tricks like Schoof, Frobenius, pairings. (By contrast, hashes are designed to minimise algebraic structure.)

Separately, as Ewin Tang can attest, an efficient quantum algorithm sometimes foreshadows an efficient classical one. We should be open to the possibility of a classical counterpart to Shor that breaks elliptic curves and RSA at once.

Also noteworthy is the striking under-representation of cryptographic breakthroughs among the 722 mathematical results OpenAI published. I've witnessed first-hand the US government censoring academic quantum cryptanalysis results. Backroom interventionism is my base case.

I urge large, sophisticated actors to lead by example. Project11's "risq list" (bitcoin-risq-list.projecteleven[.]com) is a great tracker of exposed BTC pubkeys. Binance, Bitbank, Robinhood, Bitfinex, and Tether have an opportunity to harden their cold storage. Next month I'll address institutions in London in a live Q&A (forum.ethereuminstitutional[.]org/london-2026).

Again, please do not rush. Wallets holding under 50 BTC enjoy partial cover from "Satoshi's shield", i.e. his 20K exposed addresses that hold 50 BTC each. Load-bearing signers like oracles and L2 security councils should consider rotating ECDSA pubkeys with every signed message and/or multi-signing with a hash-based schemes like SPHINCS.

Exiting bunker mode safely will require post-AI cryptography. My inclination is to go all-in on hash-based cryptography and avoid structured mathematical assumptions entirely, whether from curves, lattices, or isogenies. A single battle-tested hash (e.g. from the SHA or BLAKE families) yields plausible post-AI security.

The Ethereum roadmap on strawmap[.]org fully embraces hash-based cryptography with end-to-end formal verification as a response to the quantum threat. Those timelines must now be revisited and accelerated in light of mathematical superintelligence. I'll be pushing for maximum defensive acceleration.

原本以为只是东南亚 CryptoBilis 一家经销商的问题，没想到越查越夸张。

德国 MediaMarkt 正规门店、新加坡樟宜机场、日本电商、菲律宾零售渠道，都陆续出现了被植入恶意硬件的 Ledger。

目前曝光的地区和渠道，我全部整理了一遍：

马来西亚、印尼、菲律宾：CryptoBilis 授权经销渠道，是 Ledger 官方已确认资金被盗案例的集中来源，至少一台涉事设备已确认存在恶意硬件。

德国及欧洲：用户 @0xJohannes_  声称在两家不同的 MediaMarkt 门店买到被改装的 Nano X，拆机发现额外线缆和疑似 LTE 模块，第二台还有开箱视频。

新加坡：樟宜机场 Metapod 商店售出的 Ledger Flex 被发现植入间谍模块！买家 Ben Yorke 因设备外壳存在可疑划痕送检，Mark Karpelès 拆解发现内部额外电路板。这台设备甚至从来没有使用过。

日本：Mark Karpelès 和 Tibane Labs 从 Amazon Japan、Yahoo Auctions 等渠道取得的部分 Nano X 被发现存在硬件植入，其中有设备从马来西亚发货。

菲律宾其他零售渠道：除 CryptoBilis 外，还有用户报告在 LazMall 购买的设备存在异常植入物，Mark Karpelès 指出其中有较早期的手工线圈天线设计。

text:
parasocial attention ≠ social capital

social capital is often misappropriated as a term but can be (over)distilled as identity as currency (that’s literally what it translates to)

attention ≠ an asset

we don’t live in an attention market, at least not directly. at best, it is leverage behind the asset which sits on the connection layer; not exactly “your network is your net worth”, but how people connect to something/ to each other through something. ~it’s easy to get everyone to see something, why does it matter that they do. if attention is the market, ftx collapsing would have pumped bitcoin

broadly, in the market analogy, attention is not scarce. your own personal attention is, but even then it’s a misframed discussion

social capital increases in value in the ai world, because identity (in the most practical sense) increases in value. a misrepresentation of this is now becoming a more popular narrative, but the truth is neither in the identifier or the derivative path

in a world where everything can* be fake, the spot market of identity is the most valuable

On October 11, a content creator received a lucrative offer for a commercial shoot. The organizers paid a deposit upfront to gain their trust, then lured them to Thailand. Upon arrival, the victim was taken to an isolated house, where they faced the risk of being sold to another party

Realizing something was wrong, the victim contacted family and friends and feigned illness to buy time. According to the victim, the prospective buyers disputed the agreed price because of their apparent illness. An argument broke out, temporarily halting the transaction and buying crucial time for rescue. After receiving a request for help from the victim’s family and friends, we worked with police to pinpoint their location using phone-related leads concerning those involved, photographs the victim had taken along the journey, and a photograph of a food delivery order. We ultimately helped secure the victim’s rescue

Police subsequently took those involved in for questioning and continued examining their immigration records, travel in border areas, and possible involvement in irregular border crossings. The investigation remains ongoing

The window for intervention before victims are transferred across the Thai–Myanmar border is extremely narrow. Once they have been taken across, rescue becomes very difficult. Even when an overseas job offer includes an upfront deposit, verify the employer, the actual work location, and the people arranging the engagement

quoted_text:
Update from Ledger Donjon on the CryptoBilis investigation 🔽

@DonjonLedger is investigating Ledger signers sold by CryptoBilis, a reseller in Southeast Asia, that contained an unauthorized hardware implant. Ledger confirmed this on October 10th for one affected user's signer. All confirmed fund losses tied to the incident disclosed on October 9th involve signers sold through CryptoBilis. We have not verified a drain linked to a signer bought elsewhere. CryptoBilis has confirmed it stopped selling Ledger signers while the investigation continues.

Based on the Donjon's analysis of the attack, the implant sits inside the enclosure and reads the data shown on the screen. During setup, the signer displays the 24-word recovery phrase. When the implant detects these screens, its microcontroller decodes the words and transmits them over LTE using a provisioned eSIM. The implant is a separate component. It does not modify the Secure Element or the Ledger operating system, and it does not alter transactions or signatures.

The Donjon will analyze the signers it receives and will share more as the investigation continues.

We have not confirmed the total number of affected users or the total value lost. Figures circulating online come from third parties and Ledger has not fully verified them. If your funds were drained and you have not contacted us, please do so through Ledger Support so we can include your case. We are also reviewing reports of implants in other signers and locations. We will continue to share information as the investigation progresses. Rest assured the Ledger team is going above and beyond to leave no stone unturned to investigate this situation to the strongest possible outcome.

If you bought a Ledger signer from CryptoBilis and have not set it up, do not set it up and contact Ledger Support. If you have set it up, transfer your assets promptly to a new signer with a new recovery phrase. Do not enter or restore any recovery phrase on a signer bought from CryptoBilis. Never enter your recovery phrase into a website, app or form.

If you lost funds or hold a tampered signer, contact Ledger Support at https://t.co/QzukOZdEzq and file a report with local law enforcement. Do not send the signer to anyone before speaking with Ledger Support or local law enforcement. If you lost funds, coordinate with law enforcement before opening the signer. Researchers and others with relevant information can write to security@ledger.com.

If you did not buy from CryptoBilis and want to inspect the inside of your signer, the guide is at https://t.co/Bh9DHQulIv. Use caution and make sure your recovery phrase is backed up first, because opening a signer can damage it.

Ledger will never call you, message you directly, or ask for your 24-word recovery phrase. We will update this post when we verify new information.

"For the early years of the internet, that language was HTML. Now it is an agent to merchant conversation."

That set the tone at our Identity Panel @animocabrands's Portfolio Day, with @Ledger, @airasia Next, @Visa and @vercel , moderated by @tylerdurden88.

- From us: agent identity is a two-sided question. Is this agent here to pay, and who is the customer behind it? Merchants need both to decide how to treat the traffic.

- From Visa: merchants need three things. A trust signature to confirm the agent is legitimate, one-time limit-bound payment credentials, and customer recognition so members keep their perks.

- From AirAsia Next: agents bidding for last-minute seats could fill perishable inventory. The industry is still early though. No revenue lift yet, no loss either, so most merchants are watching and waiting.

- From Vercel: isolation is solved, identity is not. Credentials should sit at the firewall, never inside the agent's sandbox.

- From Ledger: agents handle the small stuff, with human-in-the-loop approval on hardware above a threshold. Proof of assets can also unlock better offers.

For every business, the work starts before the volume arrives. Not blocking agent traffic, but knowing which traffic is agents, verifying who they act for, and rethinking what wins the order when agents buy on criteria rather than brand.

Thanks to all our panelists for a sharp conversation.

YOUR HARDWARE WALLET WON’T SAVE YOU FROM A KNIFE TO YOUR THROAT!

10 OpSec rules every crypto holder MUST follow ↓

1. Never flex your wealth – No PnL screenshots, wallet balances, or portfolio sizes

2. Stay undoxxed – Don't publicly connect your real identity to your crypto holdings

3. Keep your location private – Never post your live location, daily routines, or even the city/country you're in

4. Use multisig wallets – Require multiple keys stored in separate secure locations for large transfers

5. Keep your seed phrases off-site – Never store all recovery methods in one place, especially at home

6. Separate your wallets – Use different wallets for daily trading and long-term holdings

7. Implement withdrawal delays – Use timelocks and spending limits to prevent instant large transfers

8. Secure your home – Install alarms, cameras, and reinforced locks

9. Protect your personal data – Use separate emails, phone numbers, and identities for crypto-related work

10. Have an emergency plan – Prioritize your life over your assets, never resist an armed attacker

Stay safe out there.

TL;DR on @contractclaus:

- What Claus is
Claus is an AI agent built around $CLAUS, an Ethereum token with an upgradeable hook attached to its main Uniswap v4 pool.

- Where the money comes from
Main-pool buys and sells carry 2.3% in disclosed fees, calculated on their ETH value. That includes a 2% project fee funding development, buybacks and burns, NFT staking payouts, and staked LP rewards, plus a 0.3% platform fee. Rewards depend on trading volume.

- The NFT setup
Deposit 50,000 CLAUS to mint one of 300 randomly assigned identities, with one direct mint per wallet. New ETH rewards now require staking, with each daily pool shared according to NFT count and time staked. There’s no minimum staking lock: unstake, then burn the NFT to redeem its 50,000 CLAUS backing.

- SPLASH
Provide both ETH and CLAUS to the main pool, then stake your full-range liquidity position to earn a share of ETH rewards. SPLASH replaces automatic liquidity additions with incentives for participating LPs.

- What’s next
The proposal is for developers and agents to launch evolving projects through @ProgrammableHQ, with Claus reviewing and approving each proposed contract upgrade before execution.

The founder also plans for ecosystem tokens to pair with CLAUS, but the exact benefits for token and NFT holders are still being designed.

text:
One interesting development with stock memes is how liquidity can evolve as more stocks become available onchain.

Four Meme’s new 4Stock mechanism is worth looking at.

Say a US stock starts trending, but Binance doesn’t have a corresponding bStock yet.

4Stock allows that stock to come onto BNB Chain earlier, giving communities the ability to launch Stock Memes and build liquidity around it.

The interesting part is what happens when bStock becomes available.

Normally, switching trading pairs means splitting liquidity or rebuilding the market.

https://t.co/qymLO4Oi6b is using PancakeSwap Infinity’s Shared Inventory Hook (SIH) to handle this differently.

Here’s how:

→ Stock Memes initially trade against 4Stock.

→ SIH lets the same meme inventory serve both 4Stock and bStock pairs.

→ Once bStock is available, a Convert Contract can gradually convert 4Stock into bStock through trades, provided there’s sufficient inventory.

This allows existing liquidity to transition without rebuilding the primary market from scratch.

I think the approach makes sense.

4Stock brings stock narratives onchain earlier, while SIH provides a path for those markets to transition as bStock coverage expands.

The real test will be whether these markets attract enough sustained trading volume to make the mechanism useful.
author: 0xAbhiP
quoted_text:
📢 https://t.co/P50JGo73zK Product Update: A Seamless Path from 4Stock to bStock

4Stock brings popular stocks onchain before their bStock is available. To ensure Stock Memes built on 4Stock can transition to bStock seamlessly, we’ve introduced a shared-inventory pool mechanism built on @PancakeSwap Infinity’s Shared Inventory Hook (SIH).

How it works:
- At graduation, a newly created Stock Meme opens its primary pool as Meme / 4Stock
- Once the corresponding bStock is live, primary liquidity migrates to Meme / bStock in one step
- The same meme inventory backs both pairs, so price and depth remain continuous and trading is never interrupted
- Only one primary pool exists at any time, keeping each token fully compatible with aggregators

No action is required from creators or holders.

More Stocks. More Memes. Make Four Great Again. 📈

本轮最惨的早期比特币投资人，出现了。

2014 到 2017 年，在中国国内，以理财名义，向十几万人非法集资，高达 400 亿元的钱志敏，那期间把一部分集资款，换成了比特币，按 2014 年 2815 元比特币买入价，现回报约 200 倍。

但这次，她跑路到的所在地，英国高等法院判定，中国的受害者，对这批币的权利要按中国法律来定，不按英国法律。

要知道加密货币在中国，一直是被提倡禁止交易，也不承认它法定货币地位。

这导致，受害者大概率最多只能拿回本金和利息，而这么多年来，比特币涨出来的那部分收益则拿不到，可能最终将归英国政府所有。

text:
从第一次创业的时候，经常听到的一句话便是：小步快跑，快速试错。

这句话直到今天都被广为传颂，尤其在一个AI可以快速完成执行的时代。

但最近越发感受到的是，选择皆有代价，当错误的选择发生而在当时有正向反馈的时刻，快速试错的结论反而会拖垮公司。

Jeff Bezo 在一封股东信中写过一个概念：单向门与双向门。

- 单向门（Type 1）代表影响重大、不可逆或很难逆转的选择。
- 双向门（Type 2）：可以调整、可以撤回。选错了还能回来的路径。

在过去创业的一年多时间里，看到最多可惜的经历都来自于天才的团队推进了错误的单向门而困在其中，比如一张比预期中要花费更多时间和资金又无法停止的牌照申请，比如一个超出团队控制的外部市场承诺，比如一次融资的资金来源和钱的属性，甚至比如pivot到一个本就不该存在的行业。

小步快跑，快速试错的本质是拉高频率构建信息优势，但这种方法论可能只建立在推动双向门的选择里，过早地推开太多本不熟悉的单向门也是一种公司失败的方式。

而相反地，最近看到的初创公司成功的共性，都来自于团队在AI足够早的时间点，构建了一个赔率极高又充满了双向门的场域，比如一个弱监管的行业，一个周转率足够高的市场，用技术迭代快速推动足够多的双向门，选择反馈路径并广播给市场。

或许 this is the way.

text:
OpenAI just got a problem no better model can fix.

For $8 a month, Elon now sells his AI, an AI coding editor, and X Premium on one bill. Microsoft ran this exact play in 1995 and erased an 80% market leader in four years without ever building the better browser.

The victim was Netscape. It owned the browser market, Microsoft made Internet Explorer free with every copy of Windows, and by 1999 Netscape was selling itself to AOL. Nobody ever found a counter to it.

Today's version is buried in Cursor's reply, where almost nobody will scroll. Paid plans get twice the coding usage on Grok models, and third-party models move to API pricing "to make room for more Grok usage."

Inside the most popular AI coding editor, that means same keystrokes, same tab-complete, one model subsidized by a $1.25 trillion parent while every rival bills at raw list price. Cursor spent three years becoming the biggest storefront for other labs' coding models. SpaceX bought the storefront in August and just repriced everyone else's shelf space.

Look at how fast this came together. February, SpaceX absorbs xAI at a $250 billion valuation. August, it buys Cursor. October, the rename to Superintelligence and one subscription covering the model, the editor, the social network, and your blue check.

Eight months, start to finish.

Bundles win because the extra product feels free. A developer already paying $30 for X plus chat plus coding has to actively talk himself into sending another lab $20 a month on top. Teams passed Slack in daily users within two years of launch for one reason. It rode a bill companies were already paying.

Netscape's browser was better than IE for most of that fight. Ask anyone under 30 if they've ever heard of it.

text:
还记得两年前轰动 AI 圈的「字节投毒实习生」田柯宇吗？

被字节开除、索赔 800 万，随后拿下 NeurIPS Best Paper。如今他创业做世界模型，项目据报道估值已达 2 亿美元。

最近，他在《elsewhere 别处发生》近两小时的播客中，首次完整回应了当年的争议，也聊了自己的科研和创业。

整理了 8 个值得关注的点。

1. 当年的「投毒」到底怎么回事？

按田柯宇的说法，2024 年组里来了一位实习生 A，长期抢占其他同事的算力，甚至直接关停别人的训练任务。

向领导反映无果后，他决定自己出手，停止 A 的程序，把资源释放出来。

2. 他承认做错了什么？

他承认干扰了对方的实验，属于严重违纪。

但他否认「植入病毒」「持续攻击两个月」「嫁祸同事」等说法。

他称自己用 GPT 帮忙写了停止程序的代码，约 10 天里手动操作了 5 次。

3. 字节当年怎么回应？

字节确认他恶意干扰了团队研究项目的训练任务，但同时澄清，网传影响 8000 多张 GPU、造成上千万美元损失严重夸大，也未波及正式商业项目和字节大模型业务。

4. 800 万索赔，最后怎么样了？

据节目披露，一审判赔约 50 万元，田柯宇表示认可，也愿意承担责任。

不过字节已经上诉，目前还在二审。

5. 那段时间，他经历了什么？

他提到，一家很想加入的大模型公司取消了 offer，自己一度担心彻底离开 AI 行业。

2024 年 12 月，VAR 论文拿下 NeurIPS Best Paper。他说当时的感受更像抓住了一根「救命稻草」。

值得注意的是，这篇论文早在当年 4 月就已经公开。

6. 为什么后来选择创业？

他进入五源资本做过 EIR，得到了孟醒的支持。

如今团队主攻世界模型。据媒体报道，已获得近 3000 万美元融资，投资方包括五源资本、IDG 资本。

他也坦言，事件热度叠加 Best Paper，客观上给创业带来了「双重 Buff」。

7. 他的世界模型路线是什么？

他从 2023 年就坚持一个方向：先让 AI 学会自己的视觉语言，再利用这种表征预测世界未来的变化。

他用一句话概括自己的兴趣：

「比起蒸馏人类，我更想蒸馏自然。」

8. 技术进展到了哪一步？

他称团队已经训练了约 9 个不同规模的模型，从几千万到几百亿参数，观察到尚未饱和的 Scaling Law。

但这些结果目前主要来自团队自述，完整模型还没有公开，仍需要验证。

听完这期播客，我反而对一个细节很感兴趣。

当年，他因为不满团队的算力分配，选择越过规则亲自干预。如今，他自己成了创业公司的 CEO，也成了那个需要制定规则、协调资源的人。

如果未来团队出现类似的冲突，他会怎么处理？

播客完整版：

加密券商模式迎来新的重磅玩家，又一个头部交易所—Bybit入局。个人一直很看好这个模式——稳定币出入金+合规美股经纪商链路，几乎是把加密的效率和TradFi的真实权益完美结合。Bybit真实股票业务正式推出，等于给币市用户又多了一个丝滑选项。简单说Bybit这次走的正是典型的“加密券商”玩法。

聊聊个人理解的几个核心点：
1、Bybit新美股业务的核心模式：加密前台+券商后台的混合体
Bybit的美股业务直连合规美股券商链路，下单入口在Bybit，后面的证券交易由合作券商承接。具体来说，Infra Capital Limited担任介绍经纪商，订单通过Alpaca执行，美国证券的清算、结算和托管由Alpaca Securities LLC提供。符合条件的持仓可以获得分红，拆股等公司行动也会按产品规则反映到持仓中。

纽交所、纳斯达克等主流市场里的股票、ETF等上类资产，都可以通过Bybit账户去交易。用户在Bybit上的股票订单通过合规经济商链路直接在美股交易所里真实成交。

所以Bybit这种加密前台+券商后台模式，也是典型“介绍经济商+白标模式”的稳定币版或者加密版，之前在这https://t.co/TLPKTikxzX   有梳理过，华人美股券商合规简史，其实老虎证券在2019年IPO上市前都是这种“介绍经纪商+白标模式”。

2、Bybit美股业务的特点
1）目前这项业务支持的是USDC，用户须完成KYC2后，才可以通过统一交易账户参与股票交易，在熟悉的Bybit入口里查看和管理股票持仓。这对已经持有USDC的人比较直接：如果想把其中一部分资金用于配置支持的美股或ETF，可以在平台内完成相关操作。

2）这次公布的范围是超过1,000只美股及ETF，热门股票全部覆盖。支持碎股的证券，符合条件的交易可以从5美元开始，碎股让配置金额更灵活。

3）资金这边，持有USDC的用户可以在平台内将其兑换成美元，用于购买股票。证券交易仍以美元结算，遵循T+1规则。对于本来就持有稳定币、又有美股配置需求的人，这样可以减少一部分跨平台安排资金的步骤。

4）真实权益+交易所级流动性：1:1背书真实美股（非合成指数），不再是“价格自动调整”那种假权益。

TradFi融入加密世界值得关注的地方
传统券商擅长的交易执行和托管，可以通过合作接入加密平台；已经习惯在平台里管理资金的用户，则获得了接触股票市场的渠道。对于用户，变化体现在日常操作里：原来拿来交易比特币的账号，现在也能用来管理美股持仓。币市用户能“不出Bybit就直通华尔街”。

本质上，Bybit在帮币圈用户把“炒美股”这件事从繁琐的TradFi流程，简化成和炒币一样简单。等于把CEX的用户黏性又往上拉了一个台阶。

个人角度加密券商模式已经从“概念”变成2026年的真战场了。CEX们纷纷杀入，不是为了抢存量，而是为了把币圈资金和用户留在自己生态里，同时吃到美股财富效应的红利。Bybit这次美股业务，相当于把“真实股票+加密效率”又往前推了一步。 而对普通用户来说，又多了一个靠谱的选择！

text:
Folio AI — v0.175.0 → v0.176.0

New capabilities
•⁠  ⁠Folio AI custom agents on web now support a real Long text input. You can add long-form multi-line fields in the agent builder, paste larger specs or feature lists, preserve line breaks to the model, and use them in both the chat composer and workflow run form. Short text and extra instruction fields still keep their existing limits, while long text fields support larger inputs with visible counters and in-field limit feedback instead of failing silently.

•⁠  ⁠Store custom pages are available beyond platform staff: sellers can use the org HTML document library to save HTML documents from chat, browse them in the picker, and build storefront custom pages on top of them.

•⁠  ⁠Running a custom agent from outside /chat on web no longer risks dropping you into an empty conversation while the run continues on the server. Starting from other Folio AI surfaces now keeps the active conversation visible once chat routing finishes, so you can launch work from elsewhere in the app and still follow the same run in chat.

•⁠  ⁠Folio AI image-preparation failures in web conversations are now surfaced as actionable incompatibility results instead of just ending the turn on input errors. If a request uses unsupported controls, formats, ratios, resolutions, source counts, or model-specific options, the assistant can now explain what is unsupported and ask for a valid alternative, which restores a previously blocked recovery path.

•⁠  ⁠When a Folio AI turn hits the stream time limit after starting image jobs, web now keeps a durable timeout notice with that turn’s job cards instead of leaving only partial output with no explanation. This makes interrupted multi-step runs much easier to understand and continue.

•⁠  ⁠On the saved-image path in Folio AI, one assistant response can now prepare multiple image jobs in a single pass instead of forcing one model pass per preparation. That makes same-turn multi-image workflows more viable, especially when you want several generated images and then a dependent follow-up step in the same conversation.

•⁠  ⁠In the order list API, clients can now request a single paginated list across multiple explicit statuses with a comma-separated status filter, which enables one combined ordered cancellation view instead of separate requests per cancellation state.

•⁠  ⁠For web uploads, one previously opaque HEIF decoder failure is now returned as a typed invalid-image response instead of an unexpected server error, so that upload path can fail in a user-handleable way rather than looking like a generic backend problem.

卧槽！Ledger 被盗事件彻底升级：欧洲正规商场、新加坡机场都发现了间谍钱包，风险正在向全球外溢！

原本以为只是东南亚 CryptoBilis 一家经销商的问题，没想到越查越夸张。

德国 MediaMarkt 正规门店、新加坡樟宜机场、日本电商、菲律宾零售渠道，都陆续出现了被植入恶意硬件的 Ledger。

目前曝光的地区和渠道，我全部整理了一遍：

马来西亚、印尼、菲律宾：CryptoBilis 授权经销渠道，是 Ledger 官方已确认资金被盗案例的集中来源，至少一台涉事设备已确认存在恶意硬件。

德国及欧洲：用户 @0xJohannes_  声称在两家不同的 MediaMarkt 门店买到被改装的 Nano X，拆机发现额外线缆和疑似 LTE 模块，第二台还有开箱视频。

新加坡：樟宜机场 Metapod 商店售出的 Ledger Flex 被发现植入间谍模块！买家 Ben Yorke 因设备外壳存在可疑划痕送检，Mark Karpelès 拆解发现内部额外电路板。这台设备甚至从来没有使用过。

日本：Mark Karpelès 和 Tibane Labs 从 Amazon Japan、Yahoo Auctions 等渠道取得的部分 Nano X 被发现存在硬件植入，其中有设备从马来西亚发货。

南美：社区开始出现类似爆料，但缺少足够的公开拆解证据。

author: Ledger
quoted_text:
Update from Ledger Donjon on the CryptoBilis investigation 🔽

@DonjonLedger is investigating Ledger signers sold by CryptoBilis, a reseller in Southeast Asia, that contained an unauthorized hardware implant. Ledger confirmed this on October 10th for one affected user's signer. All confirmed fund losses tied to the incident disclosed on October 9th involve signers sold through CryptoBilis. We have not verified a drain linked to a signer bought elsewhere. CryptoBilis has confirmed it stopped selling Ledger signers while the investigation continues.

Based on the Donjon's analysis of the attack, the implant sits inside the enclosure and reads the data shown on the screen. During setup, the signer displays the 24-word recovery phrase. When the implant detects these screens, its microcontroller decodes the words and transmits them over LTE using a provisioned eSIM. The implant is a separate component. It does not modify the Secure Element or the Ledger operating system, and it does not alter transactions or signatures.

The Donjon will analyze the signers it receives and will share more as the investigation continues.

We have not confirmed the total number of affected users or the total value lost. Figures circulating online come from third parties and Ledger has not fully verified them. If your funds were drained and you have not contacted us, please do so through Ledger Support so we can include your case. We are also reviewing reports of implants in other signers and locations. We will continue to share information as the investigation progresses. Rest assured the Ledger team is going above and beyond to leave no stone unturned to investigate this situation to the strongest possible outcome.

If you bought a Ledger signer from CryptoBilis and have not set it up, do not set it up and contact Ledger Support. If you have set it up, transfer your assets promptly to a new signer with a new recovery phrase. Do not enter or restore any recovery phrase on a signer bought from CryptoBilis. Never enter your recovery phrase into a website, app or form.

If you lost funds or hold a tampered signer, contact Ledger Support at https://t.co/QzukOZdEzq and file a report with local law enforcement. Do not send the signer to anyone before speaking with Ledger Support or local law enforcement. If you lost funds, coordinate with law enforcement before opening the signer. Researchers and others with relevant information can write to security@ledger.com.

If you did not buy from CryptoBilis and want to inspect the inside of your signer, the guide is at https://t.co/Bh9DHQulIv. Use caution and make sure your recovery phrase is backed up first, because opening a signer can damage it.

Ledger will never call you, message you directly, or ask for your 24-word recovery phrase. We will update this post when we verify new information.

text:
Deep Research 跑到 1 亿 token 语料库时，最先崩的往往是「证据管理」。

搜得越久，两个问题会很明显：

已经找到的关键证据被埋掉，后来的修正也没真正进入最终结论；同时 Agent 还在继续搜索，越搜越长，却不知道自己到底还缺什么。

这篇 LongHarness 就是专门解决这个问题。

它维护两套持续更新的状态：

EvidenceBank 保存已经确认的证据和来源；

Conclusion State 记录当前结论，以及还有哪些信息缺口没解决。

新的证据会更新结论，新的缺口再指导下一轮搜索。旧证据如果被推翻，也可以被替换或撤回，而不是一直堆在上下文里。

效果也是很明显的。

在 OfficeQA Pro 上，GLM-5.3-Flash 的准确率从 15.8% 提升到 60.2%；更难的 V2 从 4.4% 提升到 61.1%，还分别超过 Claude Code 和 Codex。

而且当语料库变大之后，LongHarness 的中位交互轮数只从 22 增加到 30，而 Claude Code 从 21 涨到 116。

以前大家更关心「能不能找到信息」，接下来会更关心哪些证据还有效，哪些结论需要更新，以及下一步到底还缺什么。

text: 一个X账户的内容，引来的老马和老黄的点赞、评论甚至转发，对于大部分人来说不仅是巨大的曝光量，还有巨大的成就感。短短一周@Bqlsj2023和@_FORAB两位都相继解锁成就。这也是几天聊到的：过去两年内三个大事件和一个趋势，让X平台在政治、地缘、科技AI和金融这些高度重视时效的领域，越来越成为全球范围内的信息中心，也越来越成为全球最有影响力的社交媒体平台，说是最强社交平台也不为过了。背后的底层逻辑看引用的推文。
author: qinbafrank
quoted_text:
三个大事件和一个趋势，让X平台在政治、地缘、科技AI和金融这些高度重视时效的领域，越来越成为全球范围内的信息中心，也越来越成为全球最有影响力的社交媒体平台（没有之一）。三个大事件：24年美国总统大选、25年关税战、26年伊朗战争（伊朗最高领袖、总统、议长、外长都启用X账号发声）；
一个趋势就是AI公司和科技领袖越来越倾向在X上发布动态、营销，打口水仗。详细说说：

1、2024年美国总统大选：关键政治人物的发声，本身就能成为平台上的重大事件
2024年7月13日，川普遇刺，这个事件迅速在网络上发酵，X是最主要的传播和讨论平台。
2024年7月21日，拜登通过社交媒体发布退选信，X是主要发布渠道之一。24年8月12日，特朗普与马斯克直接在X Spaces进行访谈。
以及之后大选的民调、选情进展，还有大选投票日的实施进展，这类事件对X平台的影响，远远超过普通热点带来的一轮流量。
当公众发现重大决定可能由当事人直接发出来，记者、政治观察者、交易者就有动力持续监测相关账号。对新闻机构而言，守在现场的必要性也随之提高。

关键人物在这里发声，记者和分析者就会关注。记者和分析者持续关注，发声者就更容易获得平台之外的传播。这种传播效果被反复验证，其他关键人物也更愿意加入。对于我们这些普通投资人来说，自然也是获取相关资讯的最快渠道。

2、2025年关税战：持续监测政策消息，开始具有非常直接的经济价值
当时川普的声明首先发布在Truth Social，但被拿来快速传播和讨论几乎都是X平台，X 在这类事件中承担了迅速汇集、转播和解释的作用。

关税战强化了 X 的另一个属性：它成为市场参与者共同监测政策变化、讨论解释的重要场所。
对于投资者而言，消息的重要性取决于它能否改变盈利、通胀、利率或风险偏好。政策如果在交易时段发生变化，持续监测的价值就会上升。

3、2026年的伊朗战争：交战方直接进入全球舆论和市场预期的争夺
这一次伊朗最高领袖开始启用X账号对外发声，战争提高了既有高层账号的国际关注度，新任最高领袖也迅速启用了官方账号。

一条公开表态可能同时被外交人员、记者和投资者阅读。不同受众会分别判断它是否意味着谈判立场改变、航运风险变化，或能源价格需要重新评估。以至于大家都觉得伊朗高层也学会了川普利用社交媒体来影响舆论的套路。

4、而“AI公司和科技领袖商业大佬越来越倾向在X上发布动态、营销，打口水仗”的这个趋势影响则更为深远
黄仁勋最近都注册了X账号开始频繁发生、扎克伯格时隔三年重新启用X账号，苹果新人CEO于9月1日首次在X上公开发帖。

LVMH 的 Bernard Arnault 在今年7月开始使用个人 X 账号，回应关于其家族和接班安排的报道；
传媒业的 David Ellison 则于10月2日首次使用 X 发布重大公司消息。

AI 产品的一个特点是，发布者可以同时给出演示、链接或测试入口，专业用户随后就能提出问题。
一次传播有可能很快从“公司宣布了什么”，进入“实际表现怎样”“哪些条件下有效”“和另一家相比有什么差别”的讨论。
对企业来说，这种即时反馈有产品价值，也有营销价值。对用户来说，原作者与专业人士的来回回应，有时比单独阅读发布稿更有信息量。

你想想一下，一个普通X账户讨论grok bot、英伟达等新闻，引来的老马和老黄的点赞、评论甚至转发，对于普通人来说不仅是巨大的曝光量，还有巨大的成就感。

当然这种趋势已经不至于AI领域，加密领域更早，其他行业也越来越多。这给 X 带来了一种相对持续的内容供给，而且发布者、评价者、产品开发者和商业决策者之间高度重叠。

5、这背后的逻辑是啥？
1）X的信息内容传播机制：公开关注和引用帖，让内容能够跨越原有圈层
X 的公开帖子可以沿关注关系传播。转帖保留原作者的内容和身份；引用帖则允许用户附加自己的评论，形成一条新的传播入口。

这种结构很适合专业信息跨圈传播。
例如，假设一名工程师写了一段芯片技术分析，AI 研究人员引用并补充，投资者再讨论对产业链的含义，记者随后联系当事人核实。同一份原始材料就可能经过几次互动，进入多个不同圈子。

每一次专业回应，都有机会让原信息接触到新的受众。
争论同样具有这种作用。一个有影响力的人反驳另一方时，也可能把对方的观点介绍给自己的关注者。因此，企业之间的公开争论有时会同时增加双方的曝光。

2）X聚集了大量“会继续传播信息的人”
政治领导人、政治家、科技大佬、商业领袖、金融投资大佬、各行业资深人士以及越老越多涌现的不同类型的博主，这些人本身就有发声的需求，也愿意传播有价值信息，当然更想让自己的观点被更多人的看到。

假设一条消息被一万个人看到，其中有大量记者、研究人员和行业意见领袖，那么后续传播可能远远超过这一万次直接触达。
就产生了一个有趣的场景：
这些人还会在自己的文章、节目、邮件和其他社交平台上继续讨论。最终受众可能没有打开过 X，却仍然接触到了从 X 进入公共讨论的议题。

这回形成马太效应，越来越多的政治名人、科技商业大佬会把X当作首选发声平台。

3）不可忽视老马的示范作用
他本人持续给平台提供值得关注的议题，马斯克涉及科技、企业经营和政治讨论，使平台拥有一个频繁制造新闻、也频繁回应新闻的人物。
这会让一部分用户即使对平台其他内容兴趣有限，也有动力继续关注。他的回复和互动，可以把新加入者迅速带进既有圈子

马斯克在多个圈层的存在，也让一条原本只属于科技圈的话题，有机会进入投资或政治讨论。

他强化了企业负责人直接发声的风格，对企业负责人来说，价值除了曝光，还包括很快接触到同行、合作伙伴及相关受众。

4）当然还有X自己的机制变化
关注关系提供稳定入口，推荐系统提供额外扩散。特别是启用AI算法之后，排序会预测用户可能发生的点赞、回复、转帖、分享、停留，以及负面反馈等行为，再综合打分。由此可以推断，突发变化、具有争议的技术判断、重要人物之间的回应，都可能形成持续互动，并获得进一步传播。

还有一点，文字本身就是一个低成本生产和低成本获取的内容形态。

所以当：
1）一手信源在这里。记者、交易员、研究员、政客、监管者和公司发言人的默认公共时间线仍是X。当最高领袖、总统、芯片CEO自己发帖时，二次传播的起点就在平台内；

2）短文本、引用帖、回复串、列表和Spaces的摩擦远低于长视频或闭源社群；算法按互动把高争议、高时效内容顶上来，所以政治、地缘和行情类信息的“第一波”往往先在这里完成扩散，再被路透、彭博、CNN等转写。Community Notes和放开后的言论尺度也让原本被限流的政治内容重新聚集。

这就导致了X还不是最大社交网络，总用户也只超过10亿，活跃用户估计也只有五到六亿，但X已经成为精英和实时公共讨论的密度最高的地方。特别是在政治、地缘、财经和前沿科技这几条线上，最快的公共信息往往先发生在X，平台的议程影响力远超其他平台。

Back from Singapore to a new ATH. $80M TVL crossed, and it's actually $85M now with inflows to Fusion vaults.

Institutional capital is THE key takeaway from my week around TOKEN2049 in Singapore. Every day was packed with back-to-back meetings with onchain allocators, custodians and chain teams, together with @DimitarDinev7. What I heard:

- Some of the largest custodians are approaching onchain through tokenized equities first, crypto second, these are TradFi players looking to repipe entire systems
- The Fusion terminal interface becomes a natural preference for people coming from TradFi. The 45 year old Bloomberg Terminal is 45 years old and still the reference point for transactions and decision making, the interface could use a UI upgrade ;)
- Demand is coming from every direction at once: exchanges, custodians, asset managers and fintechs, many of them asking for cross-chain. Hearing that the same week Chainlink named Fusion among the early CCIP Vault Adapter integrators tells me we're building exactly where the market is heading
- Chains want vault infrastructure that keeps capital working inside their own ecosystem (obviously). That feedback comes from chain teams watching some operators move capital off their chain entirely. Cross-chain done right means making assets productive within the ecosystem and focus on sticky capital and sustainable economics and yield
- People have been paying attention to Fusion's growth, and we've retaken conversations with many players we've had discussions with over the years, expect to see some new vaults and curators on Fusion

I remain extremely bullish on this space. TradFi and onchain will converge sooner than most of us anticipate

text:
why zcash got tracked and why monero wouldn't. a quick breakdown:

1/ the ledger hacker pushed eth -> tornado -> zcash shielded pool -> transparent exits to swap for usdc. 

chainalysis tracked 108 out of 108 exits. zero zero-knowledge cryptography was broken.

2/ how? zcash has "optional privacy". 

static pool size doesn't equal transaction privacy. real-time volume was low, and the hacker exited to transparent addresses to cash out.

because automated swap lots matched down to the zatoshi on exit, analysts simply correlated input batches to transparent withdrawals.

3/ why this is mathematically impossible on monero:

- no transparent addresses. everything is in a stealth address by default. you never "exit" to a public ledger.
- hidden amounts. ringct encrypts every transaction value with pedersen commitments. external observers cannot see if you moved 1 xmr or 10,000 xmr. zero value-matching.
- mandatory decoys. ring signatures mix real inputs with decoys across the entire chain automatically.

4/ optional privacy is worse than no privacy. it gives you a false sense of security while leaving a giant fingerprint on both doors.

default privacy is the only privacy that works.

quoted_text:
Ledger theft, day two. Since yesterday the thief has pushed ether through Tornado Cash three times, and each time on into Zcash's shielded pool. We followed every lot out the far side. Here is how, step by step.

1. THE SAME BUILD, THREE TIMES
An ether wallet pays a fresh splitter. The splitter pays four fresh wallets. The four drop it into Tornado Cash's 100, 10 and 1 ETH pools. Minutes, every time.

Run 1, yesterday 15:17: 1,254 ETH. Run 2, today 09:42: 1,291 ETH. Run 3, today 11:56: 450 ETH from 0xfa4EaBB840A33C156E600311433AE261CBfCb0e2, in the pools by 12:15.

2. OUT OF TORNADO CASH
The mixer breaks the link between a deposit and a withdrawal. We do not need the link. Our tooling fingerprints the withdrawal transactions themselves: how each one is constructed, who constructs it, and when. 

Yesterday's 65 withdrawals (1,084 ETH) and today's 96 (1,726 ETH) all carry the same signature. The six other withdrawals from those pools in today's windows do not. Run 3 came out from 12:18 into 0x0d697aa182801566d87adc86e68e95fd3b2f5f82 (213 ETH) and 0x676b16cc18542f37d202a1a79ac05463395496a4 (122 ETH), and 195 ETH of it was inside a cross-chain swap service by 12:38. Forty-two minutes, end to end.

3. INTO ZCASH, AND OUT AGAIN
The swap service turns the ether into shielded ZEC, where sender, amount and recipient vanish. But the service's own shielding of each lot is public, and from it we derive a value signature for that lot's exit, then scan every transparent exit from the pool. 108 of 108 exits across both days match their lot to the zatoshi. Not one other exit from the pool does. 

First lot today: in at 10:18:18, out at 11:06:16 in block 3512847 (8d26a9b095d4d28373527f7a6eb81a3be7f906d1e2190960c0512ff64f369418 and 738c6d1261e79766e4dd16bdbd38dced91b8e3a86ce41dcda83eda1f19208fbf), straight into a ZEC to USDC order.

Today so far: 20 lots ordered (2,379 ZEC, $2.9m), 14 out, 5 inside the pool, 1 still settling. Every exit feeds a ZEC to USDC order paying two wallets born at 11:11, 22 of the 28 paid by 12:43:
0x816D5Ee17DB1495d1409F135b98FF3edc5F3cDf8: 940,561 USDC
0xBA736A4b616e79867B6d586293966b552883f3F3: 852,258 USDC
1.79m USDC, unspent. @Circle can freeze it.

quoted_text:
Update from Ledger Donjon on the CryptoBilis investigation 🔽

@DonjonLedger is investigating Ledger signers sold by CryptoBilis, a reseller in Southeast Asia, that contained an unauthorized hardware implant. Ledger confirmed this on October 10th for one affected user's signer. All confirmed fund losses tied to the incident disclosed on October 9th involve signers sold through CryptoBilis. We have not verified a drain linked to a signer bought elsewhere. CryptoBilis has confirmed it stopped selling Ledger signers while the investigation continues.

Based on the Donjon's analysis of the attack, the implant sits inside the enclosure and reads the data shown on the screen. During setup, the signer displays the 24-word recovery phrase. When the implant detects these screens, its microcontroller decodes the words and transmits them over LTE using a provisioned eSIM. The implant is a separate component. It does not modify the Secure Element or the Ledger operating system, and it does not alter transactions or signatures.

The Donjon will analyze the signers it receives and will share more as the investigation continues.

We have not confirmed the total number of affected users or the total value lost. Figures circulating online come from third parties and Ledger has not fully verified them. If your funds were drained and you have not contacted us, please do so through Ledger Support so we can include your case. We are also reviewing reports of implants in other signers and locations. We will continue to share information as the investigation progresses. Rest assured the Ledger team is going above and beyond to leave no stone unturned to investigate this situation to the strongest possible outcome.

If you bought a Ledger signer from CryptoBilis and have not set it up, do not set it up and contact Ledger Support. If you have set it up, transfer your assets promptly to a new signer with a new recovery phrase. Do not enter or restore any recovery phrase on a signer bought from CryptoBilis. Never enter your recovery phrase into a website, app or form.

If you lost funds or hold a tampered signer, contact Ledger Support at https://t.co/QzukOZdEzq and file a report with local law enforcement. Do not send the signer to anyone before speaking with Ledger Support or local law enforcement. If you lost funds, coordinate with law enforcement before opening the signer. Researchers and others with relevant information can write to security@ledger.com.

If you did not buy from CryptoBilis and want to inspect the inside of your signer, the guide is at https://t.co/Bh9DHQulIv. Use caution and make sure your recovery phrase is backed up first, because opening a signer can damage it.

Ledger will never call you, message you directly, or ask for your 24-word recovery phrase. We will update this post when we verify new information.

预测市场还能承担社会价值？
凭什么猜一场比赛叫赌博，猜一只股价的涨跌就叫金融。
美国职业橄榄球联盟最近插手了关于Kalshi的争议案件，要闹到最高法院。
我今天想让你思考一个问题：同样是花钱押结果，从社会价值、经济学的角度来看，为什么不能把预测市场和赌场划上等号。
00:25 交易结构上的区别
01:00 从投机角度来看，预测市场在风险转移、价格发现上的经济价值，类比传统期货市场。
03:00 预测市场的社会成本——激励与风险。不止是内幕消息，当一个人可以左右事件结果，甚至事件涉及选举、战争或公共安全，会发生什么？
03:54 金融创新的边界，一直在增加价值与减少代价之间徘徊。我认为预测市场是金融创新，因为我不想从预测的准确性去判断它，我会看它有没有帮助人们管理风险、作出决定？为了这些价值，又让谁承担了成本？

不要因为一份合约预测的是股价，就认定它天然有价值。反而，某些天气预测却可能帮助农业或物流企业提前安排业务。
不同的事件，能带来的价值和风险都不一样，体育预测也不因为标的是球赛，就必然毫无信息价值。
金融创新让我们拥有了越来越多交易未来的工具，但技术能做到什么，和我们应该允许它做什么，始终是两个需要分别回答的问题。

text:
One of the most compelling features of Flying Tulip’s TRS is what happens when your limit order NEVER fills. $FT @flyingtulip_ 

Your eligible collateral keeps earning while you wait. With borrowing deferred until execution, cancelling an unfilled entry leaves no new trading loan to repay.

That means a lower cost of waiting—and less work when you change your mind.

Here’s the comparison.

1/ Conventional perps

An unfilled entry order pays no funding. Cancelling it is straightforward too.

But in a setup with non-earning margin, the capital committed to that order earns nothing while waiting.

Leave the order open for days or weeks, and that opportunity cost accumulates. Moving the money elsewhere to earn may mean cancelling the order and bringing funds back when you want to trade again.

FT lets eligible collateral keep earning while supporting the pending order.

2/ Aave + DeFi Saver: borrowing before placing the order

Your Aave collateral continues earning. But once you borrow funds for a separate limit order, the debt starts accruing interest.

The order might sit unfilled for a week. The borrowing cost keeps accumulating.

Eventually decide against the trade?

Cancelling the order does not cancel the loan.

You still need to repay the borrowed funds plus accrued interest. If those funds were deployed elsewhere while waiting, you also need to retrieve them.

The trade never happened, but the financing did.

3/ Flying Tulip’s integrated flow

For an entry financed only when it executes:

• While waiting: eligible collateral earns, with no new position financing.
• If you change your mind: cancel the order and leave the assets earning.
• If it executes: financing begins with the actual position.

There is no loan opened solely to prepare for an entry that might never happen.

A fair qualification: DeFi Saver supports price-triggered automation for eligible strategies, which can defer additional borrowing. Some perp platforms also offer yield-bearing collateral. Those setups narrow the difference.

What makes FT attractive is having productive collateral and pending orders connected within the same account.

Capital efficiency matters during the days you spend waiting—and on the trades you ultimately never make.

text:
K33: U.S. Government's 17,733 BTC Transfers Likely Custody-Related, Not Sales

K33 Research reported that U.S. government-linked wallets transferred approximately 17,733 BTC to Coinbase Prime in early October, including 12,267 BTC tied to the Bitfinex hack. Labeled government holdings fell from 324,527 BTC to 306,795 BTC. Including suspected but unlabeled government wallets, total transfers may have reached 21,500 BTC.

K33 said most transfers likely involved custody arrangements rather than sales, as Coinbase Prime serves as custodian for the U.S. Marshals Service and the Bitfinex assets remain subject to a claims process. However, roughly 1,200 BTC linked to the FTX and HashFlare cases could potentially be sold to fund cash compensation for victims.

text:
Firelight's Jesus Rodriguez says DeFi faces a hundreds-of-billions insurance gap, and the biggest insurer covers only a few dozen million

"Every market since the 1700s, every financial market has had an insurance component attached to it."

"DeFi tried to solve this problem in the past. They have been very good projects, they just haven't achieved critical mass."

"And what you're facing today is this gap that DeFi is facing, the hundreds of billions. And the biggest protocol doing this has a few dozen millions in cover."

"And then you have other issues that you're using DeFi to insure DeFi, so you're using a riskier protocol to insure a safer protocol, so it doesn't make sense conceptually."

"The problem that you have as a newcomer in this space is that you need to start with billions, right? You need to start with a scale, which you never want to face as a new startup."

text:
So, for those of you who missed it, Illinois just dropped its draft rules for their no good, very bad Digital Asset Tax and, y’all, it’s a mess, especially for DeFi.

The proposed rules would treat a DEX (not an interface, the protocol itself) that charges a “protocol fee” as a “broker” that must register with the state, collect a 0.2% tax on the full value of every swap by an Illinois user, and keep each user’s address, IP, and W-9. Effectively mandated KYC.

It also requires brokers to keep customers’ private keys… I don’t even know where to begin on that one.

Essentially a worse version of the repealed IRS broker rule.

Thankfully @BlockchainAssn, @crypto_council, and the @DigitalChamber have sued the state, but we need a full court press on this from a political and policy perspective.

It’s my personal #1 priority, because I doubt Illinois will be the last to try this.

text:
我一直认为，RWA 这个赛道最大的机会，不仅仅是把已经上市的股票搬到链上，而是让普通投资者有机会接触到原本很难参与的资产。

新加坡参会期间现场关注到了 @Ondo 和 的新产品 Ondo Private Markets，我觉得这个方向非常值得聊聊。

过去大家想投资 SpaceX、OpenAI 这类尚未上市的明星企业，门槛其实非常高。

大多数投资机会集中在 VC、PE 和机构手里。等到这些企业真正 IPO，可能已经经历了好几轮估值增长，普通投资者只能在二级市场接盘。

Ondo Private Markets 想解决的，就是这个问题。
简单理解，它把未上市公司的经济敞口代币化，让符合资格的投资者在企业 IPO 之前，就有机会参与其价值变化。
我认为有几个非常值得关注的地方：

1. 不需要等到 IPO 才能参与。
Ondo Private Markets 提供的是代币化票据，其经济价值与对应私营公司在符合条件的流动性事件中的每股价值挂钩。
这里需要强调，它不是公司股票，也不代表股东身份，没有投票权等股东权利。

2. Pre-IPO 资产也有机会实现 7×24 小时交易。
传统私募市场有一个非常大的问题，就是流动性差。
买进去可能要等好几年才能退出，而 Ondo Private Markets 的票据可以在 Ondo Perps 现货订单簿交易，也支持自托管，以及向其他符合资格的持有人转让。
当然，支持全天候交易不等于保证流动性，实际成交价格也可能与企业估值存在明显偏差。

3. 首批标的选择了 AI 赛道。
Ondo 在发布产品时宣布，首个市场将围绕一家领先的 Pre-IPO AI 企业展开，后续计划覆盖机器人、网络安全、生物科技、基础设施等领域。

我认为这个切入点非常聪明。
这几年全球最有想象力的科技企业，有相当一部分仍然处于私营阶段，而 Crypto 用户对于 AI 资产的关注度本身就非常高。

对我来说，Ondo Private Markets 最有吸引力的地方，不是又多了一个可以交易的代币，而是链上金融正在从上市资产，进一步延伸到一级市场和私募资产。

不过这类产品也不是人人都能买，需要满足司法管辖区、非美国人士身份及 KYC 等资格要求。

过去我们讨论 RWA，更多讨论的是资产上链。
现在我更关注的是，资产上链之后，能不能真正改变全球投资者获取资产和交易资产的方式。

如果未来越来越多优质私营企业的经济敞口能够进入链上，并形成足够的二级市场流动性，我认为这才是 RWA 真正值得期待的地方。@Ondo

quoted_text:
We're launching our leaderboard for FrontierCode 1.1, a private evaluation from Cognition that tests models on completing coding tasks in a way that would actually get merged by maintainers of real-world repositories

@cognition announced FrontierCode in June 2026 and updated it to version 1.1 in July. Cognition built the dataset with open source maintainers who spent more than 40 hours per task. Each task requires the agent to make a change to a real open source repository, then checks both unit tests and qualitative tests for what maintainers would require to merge the change.

We run FrontierCode 1.1 Main, the primary 100-task set of the benchmark's 150 tasks, using our Stirrup open source reference harness for apples-to-apples comparisons across models. All tasks are private to avoid contamination. Each attempt is graded with both blocking and non-blocking criteria. An attempt that fails any blocking check scores zero, and one that passes them all scores between 70% and 100%.

Unlike other coding evaluations, FrontierCode has a more holistic view of success based on real usage. Models need to pass unit tests, but are also assessed on behaviors like making excessive changes and large diffs, modifying files outside the relevant scope, or adding unhelpful tests. We think this approach is valuable in the current context: models are now very capable at coding tasks, but their changes can still require substantial cleanup before a maintainer would merge them.

Key takeaways:

➤ Leading models still fail more than 40% of the time: Claude Opus 5.5 (max with fallback) leads at a score of 52% after passing blockers in 58% of its attempts. Nine of the 100 tasks were not passed in any attempt by any of the models we evaluated for launch

➤ The top of the leaderboard is tightly packed: nine models from six labs score between 43% and 52%. MiMo-V2.6-Pro is the leading open weights model at 45%, followed by DeepSeek V4.1 Flash (max) and Kimi K3 (max) at 44%

➤ GPT-6.1 Sol (max) offers the strongest performance for its cost: At $0.81 per task it scores 49%, matching Claude Fable 5.1 (max with fallback). This means it achieves similar performance to leading Anthropic models, at less than a tenth of the cost per task

Thank you to @silasalberti, @ybenpan, @cl571128, and the rest of the team at Cognition for building FrontierCode and collaborating with us to bring it to Artificial Analysis - we’re working to add FrontierCode to our coding agent leaderboard very soon.

quoted_text:
📊 BITTORRENT CLIENT MATRIX: THE SCALE BEHIND THE NUMBERS @BitTorrent 

The latest weekly snapshot from the BitTorrent ecosystem shows that decentralized file-sharing infrastructure continues to operate at a massive global scale.

The headline numbers are impressive, but the real story is how consistently different BitTorrent products contribute to that overall network footprint.

▫️ Gross Reach: 47.94M ethereum:0xc669928185dbce49d2230cc9b0979be6dc797957 

With nearly 47.94 million users reached, the BitTorrent ecosystem maintains a substantial presence across desktop, web, and mobile environments.

That reach is important because it demonstrates that BitTorrent is not dependent on a single application or a single platform.

Instead, multiple products work together to create a broad distribution layer for users around the world.

▫️ Average DAU: 8.53M

An average of 8.53 million daily active users provides another important signal.

Reach tells us how many users the ecosystem can touch.

Daily activity shows how many people continue returning and using the products.

That distinction matters when evaluating the strength of a long-running consumer technology ecosystem.

🔥 uTorrent Desktop Leads Daily Activity

The desktop segment continues to be a major contributor, with uTorrent Desktop recording 4.31M daily active users.

This highlights the continuing importance of desktop-based torrent clients even as internet usage increasingly shifts toward mobile devices and browser-based applications.

The desktop product remains a significant gateway into the BitTorrent ecosystem.

🌐 BitTorrent Web: 21.7% Stickiness

BitTorrent Web recorded 21.7% stickiness, showing meaningful recurring engagement within the web experience.

For a browser-based product, stickiness is especially interesting because it reflects the ability to bring users back rather than simply generating one-time visits.

The web layer therefore adds another dimension to BitTorrent's overall product ecosystem.

📱 Mobile Footprint Keeps Expanding

On mobile, uTorrent Android reached 7.02M users, reinforcing the importance of smartphones in the modern BitTorrent user journey.

Users are no longer limited to one environment.

They can interact with BitTorrent-related products across desktop, browser, and mobile platforms depending on their needs.

🚀 THE BIGGER PICTURE

When these numbers are viewed together, the strength of BitTorrent becomes easier to understand.

47.94M gross reach.

8.53M average daily active users.

4.31M daily active users on uTorrent Desktop.

21.7% BitTorrent Web stickiness.

7.02M uTorrent Android reach.

These are not isolated statistics.

They represent different layers of a broader client ecosystem serving millions of users across multiple environments.

And that diversity is important.

A strong technology network is not only measured by how many people know about it.

text:
Karpathy 說 LLM 能力的認知落差正在變成「斷崖式漏斗」

以全球約 83 億人口為準：

60 億人（72.3%）：幾乎沒碰過 LLM。

10–20 億人（12.0%–24.1%）：只把它當聊天機器人或更好的搜尋引擎。

約 2,000 萬人（0.24%）：數學、程式專業使用者，已經看到 Agent 能把過去數週到數月的專案，用一個 Prompt 大幅完成。

約 5,000 人（0.00006%）：真正站在前沿，看到成千上萬個 Agent 協作數週，進行科學發現、數學突破與機器速度的攻防。

最震撼的是：全球每 100 萬人，只有約 0.6 人站在最前沿。

也就是說，真正看到 AI 能力極限的人，可能連全球人口的十萬分之一都不到。

現在多數人覺得「AI 沒那麼神」，極少數人卻覺得「曲線垂直上升」。這兩種感覺同時存在，而且落差還在擴大。
author: shawnchen_eth
quoted_text:
Dusting off this tweet from April because this gap in shared understanding of LLM capability is *widening*. It's now less "two groups of people speaking past each other" and more a sharp funnel.

- Napkin math somewhere around 6B people (~75% of the population) have barely come in contact with LLMs at all.
- Around 1-2B (~20%) are casual and infrequent users of free-tier ChatGPT-like products. This group sees derpy chatbots and treats them a bit like a better Google search, a writing aid, or etc. Maybe an agent tries to book you a flight. I have non-tech friends who (reasonably, imo) say they have not much use for it at all. Even many professionals outside of math&code are in this tier. For example, execs and many other functions spend a lot of their time talking to other people, so while they understand what is happening intellectually, it is still second-hand and a bit abstract.
- Now we get to professional use of frontier-grade LLMs in math&code. Somewhere around 20M people (0.2%) see first-hand that large, complex projects that used to take them weeks/months can now be completed by agents with a prompt. Building apps, copying apps, translating apps, decompiling apps from binaries... This has all happened very quickly and recently - less than 1 year ago, I was writing code manually by hand, typing memorized computer code commands into a code editor character by character, occasionally pressing Tab to autocomplete a little chunk of code.
- And finally we get to the ~5,000 people (~0.00006%) with access to frontier-grade systems internally. The external world has seen the preview. It looks like swarms of thousands of agents collaborating over weeks on software mega projects: minting zero days, running cyber attacks and defenses at machine speeds, discovering new science, advancing the frontier of mathematics. Things that would have taken top professionals in the industry years of work. Meanwhile, human review and comprehension are starting to fall behind. For example, people are still involved in the "archeology" of the OpenAI-HF incident from many months ago. Mathematicians may be poring over the 722 manuscripts on frontier mathematics for a while.

The funnel is driven by a combination of factors:
1. The impact scales with ambition, problem size, and horizon. A question with a paragraph answer barely stresses the system. You need a reservoir of big, difficult problems that you really care about. This aspect drives the consumer / professional dimension of the funnel.
2. The jaggedness of the system (which I have written about a lot separately). Capability peaks in domains that are digital, verifiable and economically valuable. This is because LLM capability emerges from reinforcement learning on verifiable rewards on a curated environment mixture driven by revenue potential. This aspect primarily drives the area (e.g. math&code) dimension of the funnel.
3. Access. Free-tier, paid-tier, internal.

So this is the weirdness of the moment. The general public has mostly not interacted with these systems. When they have, it looks like a derpy chatbot. The majority of professionals still see only a modest uplift. And a small sliver of professionals are experiencing the vertigo of the curve going vertical. And it is all happening at the same time.

author: openservai
quoted_text:
We’re building SERV to become core infrastructure for Enterprise AI.

Our early work with Neol gave us a major advantage in building toward our vision.

We had the opportunity to develop SERV against live production workloads across companies and governments, including the UAE government, while establishing a growing footprint across the Middle East.

That meant access to real-world data and learnings that no theoretical framework or whitepaper could provide.

These learnings shaped v1 and v2 of SERV Reasoning, moving our technology from a theoretical framework to a real-world use case, which now feeds directly into SERV v3 and Graph Sharding, the next stage of the reasoning engine.

Neol runs network intelligence for governments and institutions, where agents surface real people for high-stakes decisions. In these environments, “usually right” isn’t good enough. The reasoning needs to be reliable, reproducible, and auditable.

On one of Neol’s production agents, the same evaluation was run 2,400 times:
- Prompt-engineered stack: 54.1% reliability
- SERV research applied directly: 63.1%
- Full SERV Reasoning methodology: 100% across every category

SERV moved the workload from open-ended reasoning into structured decision graphs, then applied learnings from production, including subgraph decomposition and binary judgments, to make the reasoning more deterministic and testable.

Higher reliability was only one part of the result. Neol gained an inspectable reasoning structure where results can be traced back to specific decisions, making the system easier to test, improve, and defend when challenged.

Our vision is to make SERV the reasoning layer enterprises and institutions rely on to run AI at scale. Neol is an early proof point of this journey.

ok this is going too far, even europeans are getting hit by the ledger supply chain attack.

here's how to be 100% sure you're not impacted:

1/ the genuine check is useless for this. it only verifies the secure element. the implant is next to it and listens to the screen data without touching the se or firmware. a compromised device still passes it clean.

2/ only real check is opening the device and comparing the inside to ledger's official hardware integrity photos. look for any extra board, wires, lte module, antenna, or modified battery near the screen. if you see anything extra, it's compromised.

3/ if you already set up a device bought from any reseller (mediamarkt, cryptobilis, etc.), move your funds now to a brand new device purchased directly from @Ledger with a completely new seed. never reuse the old one.

4/ devices bought straight from ledger are the lowest risk. even then, physical inspection is the only way to be certain.

software checks won't catch this. if in doubt, treat it as compromised and migrate.

BREAKING: 🇪🇺 The Ledger supply chain in Europe has now also been compromised, according to some reports.

Users reportedly found a hidden cellular module with an antenna inside Ledger devices bought from MediaMarkt, an official reseller in Germany and Austria.

It comes just days after devices sold by a major supplier in Southeast Asia, CryptoBilis, were found with a hidden implant. Researchers say it had an LTE chip and an e-SIM that can send out your recovery phrase.

That attack drained $86M to $93M from 300+ wallets on Oct 9.

If you use Ledger:

• Stop using any device you bought from a reseller.

• Move your funds to a new wallet with a new seed phrase.

If you bought a Ledger signer from CryptoBilis and have not set it up, do not set it up. If you have set it up, transfer your assets promptly to a new signer with a new recovery phrase. Ledger will never call you, message you directly or ask for your 24-word recovery phrase.

author: PabloSabbatella
quoted_text:
Update from Ledger Donjon on the CryptoBilis investigation 🔽

@DonjonLedger is investigating Ledger signers sold by CryptoBilis, a reseller in Southeast Asia, that contained an unauthorized hardware implant. Ledger confirmed this on October 10th for one affected user's signer. All confirmed fund losses tied to the incident disclosed on October 9th involve signers sold through CryptoBilis. We have not verified a drain linked to a signer bought elsewhere. CryptoBilis has confirmed it stopped selling Ledger signers while the investigation continues.

Based on the Donjon's analysis of the attack, the implant sits inside the enclosure and reads the data shown on the screen. During setup, the signer displays the 24-word recovery phrase. When the implant detects these screens, its microcontroller decodes the words and transmits them over LTE using a provisioned eSIM. The implant is a separate component. It does not modify the Secure Element or the Ledger operating system, and it does not alter transactions or signatures.

The Donjon will analyze the signers it receives and will share more as the investigation continues.

We have not confirmed the total number of affected users or the total value lost. Figures circulating online come from third parties and Ledger has not fully verified them. If your funds were drained and you have not contacted us, please do so through Ledger Support so we can include your case. We are also reviewing reports of implants in other signers and locations. We will continue to share information as the investigation progresses. Rest assured the Ledger team is going above and beyond to leave no stone unturned to investigate this situation to the strongest possible outcome.

If you bought a Ledger signer from CryptoBilis and have not set it up, do not set it up and contact Ledger Support. If you have set it up, transfer your assets promptly to a new signer with a new recovery phrase. Do not enter or restore any recovery phrase on a signer bought from CryptoBilis. Never enter your recovery phrase into a website, app or form.

If you lost funds or hold a tampered signer, contact Ledger Support at https://t.co/QzukOZdEzq and file a report with local law enforcement. Do not send the signer to anyone before speaking with Ledger Support or local law enforcement. If you lost funds, coordinate with law enforcement before opening the signer. Researchers and others with relevant information can write to security@ledger.com.

If you did not buy from CryptoBilis and want to inspect the inside of your signer, the guide is at https://t.co/Bh9DHQulIv. Use caution and make sure your recovery phrase is backed up first, because opening a signer can damage it.

Ledger will never call you, message you directly, or ask for your 24-word recovery phrase. We will update this post when we verify new information.
